name: Alex Chen

projects.title: StudySync - Collaborative Real-Time Study Room
projects.description: Built a responsive web application allowing university students to join live virtual study rooms with integrated Pomodoro timers, shared markdown notes, and WebRTC audio chat. Implemented responsive UI with React and TailwindCSS, managing real-time room state via Socket.io client.
highlights: Reduced initial bundle load time by 38% using dynamic code splitting and lazy loading of modals.
Created an accessible design system with 100% WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation compliance.

projects.title: CampusEats - University Food Delivery Tracker
projects.description: Developed an interactive web map tracking food trucks and campus dining hall crowds. Designed dynamic filterable UI with real-time ETA updates and mobile-first responsive layout.
highlights: Implemented custom debounce hook for search queries to prevent excess map re-renders.
